result.topic_en: Riemann shows that the coefficients of the linear differential equation satisfied by a system of functions of a given class are proportional to Wronskian-type partial determinants, which are polynomials times powers of (x-a), (x-b), …; he then states corollaries: such functions satisfy an n-th order linear ODE with polynomial coefficients, and every system of the same class is a rational linear combination of the y's and their first n-1 derivatives.
